why_agent_cannot: accept the project's terms in your own name
what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the OctoSwap liquidity page Go to the liquidity page , where the banner announces the live point program and the pools are listed with their APR, fee tier and TVL.
2 Step 2 : Get the pool's two assets on Monad Adding liquidity to a pool involves the two assets that make up that pool. OctoSwap is on Monad, so use a wallet on Monad.
3 Step 3 : Check which pools are marked Points Eligible The list on the homepage shows a Points Eligible mark on some pools. Pick the pool you want to fund from the list.
4 Step 4 : Add liquidity to the pool Press Add on the pool to add liquidity; the banner says adding liquidity earns points.
5 Step 5 : Note the Octo ID option The banner says Octo ID is live and that minting it gives boosted points. The pages give no cost or boost size.
